sonnet.problem: This true/false card mostly repeats card 2. Card 2's right answer is that the LORD goes before them and will fight for them, and card 3 asks again whether the LORD fought for them, both from verse 30. This is the same point asked twice, and a True statement here just restates the card before it.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it. ... An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: The question says the people "feared" their children would become captives. Verse 39 says only that the people "said" the little ones would become captives. "Feared" adds a feeling as fact, without marking it as Papa Dorin's own guess.
sonnet.rule: He can guess at a feeling, marked as his own ("I think," "I bet"). Never as fact.
